newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Biota shares go higher on drug trials.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Biota shares go higher on drug trials.

text.p: Shares in drug developer Biota Holdings Ltd jumped in mid-morning trading after the company said it expected to move to phase III trials of its GG167 influenza treatment in 1997, brokers said.
By 10.55 a.m. (0155 GMT), Biota shares were 10 cents up at A$4.10 in a weak market after hitting an intraday high of A$4.29 in early trading.
The company said it anticipated filing for regulatory approval for the drug in the second half of 1998.
Biota's partner in the development and trialling of GG 167 is U.K.-based pharmaceutical giant Glaxo Wellcome Plc.
In a statement, the company said that GG167 had shown significant efficacy over placebo in the treatment of influenza patients with no significant side-effects to date.
"The shares are up on the back of the announcement. They are still making progress," said a Sydney broker.
The company also said it had signed agreements with U.S. companies Binax Inc and Biostar Inc to develop a novel rapid test for on-the-spot diagnosis of influenza.
At 12.15 p.m. (0130 GMT), Biota shares were up 15 cents at A$4.15 in choppy trade on turnover of 99,840 shares.
